hero.filename: US Coast Guard HH-60 medevac Deepwater Horizon rig.jpg
hero.caption: Emergency medical technicians rush a gurney to an awaiting HH-60 rescue helicopter and crew from Coast Guard Aviation Training Center Mobile, Alabama, on Coast Guard Air Station New Orleans. The helicopter crew medevaced multiple survivors from the mobile offshore drilling unit Deepwater Horizon after an explosion and fire caused the crew of the vessel to evacuate.
hero.alt: Emergency medical technicians rush a gurney to an awaiting HH-60 rescue helicopter and crew from Coast Guard Aviation Training Center Mobile, Alabama, on Coast Guard Air Station New Orleans. The helicopter crew medevaced multiple survivors from the mobile offshore drilling unit Deepwater Horizon after an explosion and fire caused the crew of the vessel to evacuate.

images.filename: Deepwater Horizon offshore drilling unit on fire 2010.jpg
images.caption: Platform supply vessels battle the blazing remnants of the off shore oil rig Deepwater Horizon. A Coast Guard MH-65C dolphin rescue helicopter and crew document the fire aboard the mobile offshore drilling unit Deepwater Horizon, while searching for survivors. Multiple Coast Guard helicopters, planes and cutters responded to rescue the Deepwater Horizon's 126 person crew.

images.filename: BP’s Deepwater Horizon rig on fire in the Gulf of Mexico. (15010938489).jpg
images.caption: BP’s Deepwater Horizon rig on fire in the Gulf of Mexico. On April 20, 2010, the oil drilling rig Deepwater Horizon, operating in the BP-operated Macondo Prospect in the Gulf of Mexico, exploded and sank, resulting in the death of 11 workers on the Deepwater Horizon and the largest marine oil spill to date. Approximately 4.9 billion barrels of oil flowed from the damaged Macondo well over an 87-day period before it was finally capped on July 15, 2010. In response to the BP oil spill, a massive cleanup effort began, during which EPA monitored air, water, sediment, and waste generated by the cleanup operations. In 2012, BP settled federal criminal charges with the Department of Justice and pled guilty to 11 counts of manslaughter, two misdemeanors, and a felony count of lying to Congress.
